Copy of the running script: /var/log/bsc/<env>-snapshot.log.running.<pid>.

releases.title: BSC official snapshot (not genesis IBD)
notes: BNB mainnet from genesis is months (0.1%/hours at 7%). ExtraStep downloads official bnb-chain/bsc-snapshots via fetch-snapshot.sh (aria2 + lz4). Default pruned ~1.7 TB; picker full ~6.6 TB. Honest % from aria2/parts. After Update the pipeline writes the unit if missing, stops the node, and wipes geth/ when there is no marker. Do not Restart during download/extract.

releases.title: TON NOFILE 4M + fs.nr_open 8M
notes: validator-engine asks 1.5M fds. LimitNOFILE=4194304 and fs.nr_open=8388608 so setrlimit is not tight against the Ubuntu 1M ceiling. Heal rewrites the drop-in; do not Restart mid-apply.

releases.title: TON setrlimit: 1.5M NOFILE + fs.nr_open
notes: validator-engine change_maximize_rlimit(nofile, 1572864) logged PosixError EPERM against Ubuntu fs.nr_open 1048576 and LimitNOFILE=1048576. Drop-in + sysctl before install.sh starts the engine. Heal on collect. Do not Restart mid-apply.

releases.title: TON dump 100%: extracting is not stuck
notes: After aria2 100% the UI no longer sits on a stale «extracting dump» while install.sh compiles or the validator applies. Live tar/lz4 still shows extracting + elapsed. tha=0 and 99.9% are a hold until seqno>0 — not Synced.

releases.title: Soft-stop fullnode from the node page

Apt / docker_extract / empty artifact_url stay an honest error — there is nothing to replace.

releases.title: TON dump apply — stop killing validator at 99%

MyTonCtrl rewrites validator ExecStart; heal no longer SIGKILL-recycles while apply is running.
After OOM or a restart, celldb cache is capped to 1G and MemoryMax=85%.
Sync shows restart / apply OOM instead of a fake «applying» line.
